info:
The simulation is split into two parts: 
 
 Transit analysis: calculation of network coverage (you need to provide a zonage.geojson file with columns 'xxx_density' in item/km² for each category relevant (population, jobs, health facilities...), required fleet size, line lengths, connections, operating costs, round trip times... 
 The model returns tables and GIS layers summing up the properties of the transport lines. 
 
 Pathfinder: can be performed using either timetables (a timetable needs to have been provided for each line of the network) or headways (providing headway fields in the links). 
 The model returns isochrones showing travel time between stops of the network (or between zones of the zonage file if provided) and shortest paths for origin-destination couples defined under the “OD” tab. 
 
 Full documentation is available here: https://systragroup.github.io/quetzal-network-editor-doc/trainings/01_transit_dca.html

params.hint: Distance from a station within which a geographic area is considered to be served (used to compute network coverage)
params.name: road_pt_factor

params.hint: Coefficient applied to travel times for modes using the road network (not used if timetables are used)
params.name: road_pt_factor

params.hint: Time a vehicle remains stopped at a stop while passengers board and alight (not used if timetables are used)
params.name: stop_interval

params.hint: Use road network to compute population mesh
params.name: use_road_network

params.hint: Factor to compute yearly indicators from daily basis
params.name: coef_day_to_year

params.hint: Radius of le clustering zone to identify common sections between PT routes
params.name: clustering_radius

params.hint: Max length for a footpath (walk distance between stations)
params.name: max_length

params.hint: As the crow flight walking speed
params.name: speed

params.hint: Number of connection between the origin (or destination) and the footpaths
params.name: n_ntlegs

params.hint: Start time of the period (format HH:mm:ss)
params.name: start_time

params.hint: End time of the period (format HH:mm:ss)
params.name: end_time

params.hint: Minimum time needed for a transfer from a line to another
params.name: min_transfer_time

params.hint: Time penalty applied for best itinerary selection penalizing itineraries with connections.
params.name: transfer_penalty

params.hint: Period (to choose among periods defined in links)
params.name: period
